set.body: Add general image-layer destination/workspace kernels for primitive-grid pull, dense SoA map composition, linear map regridding, analytic finite-difference Jacobian reduction, validity masks, and anti-aliased pyramids. Avoid boxed per-voxel WorldPoint/Vector/stencil graphs. Preserve current typed APIs and prove parity against existing resampling/morphism oracles on JVM and JS.
set.title: HalfFlow 1: allocation-controlled image field kernels
